name: Autocephalous Patriarchate
description: Meaning #italic self-headed#!, an $autocephalous_patriarchate$ is a Metropolitan bishop in the Eastern Christian confessions which acts independently and does not subordinate or answer to any other hierarchically superior Church authority. The different patriarchates have then their own synods of bishops to decide anything affecting their own religious jurisdiction.

name: Catholic Church
description: The $catholic_church$ is a grand religious organization which goes beyond national borders. Theocrats of all kinds and of every state are emissaries of the Holy See in [ShowLocationName('rome')]. The Bishop of [ShowLocationNameWithNoTooltip('rome')] and head of the $catholic_church$ is the ruler of the [GetCountry('PAP').GetName].

name: Coalition
description: A Coalition is a group of [countries|e] that band together due to their [antagonism|e] towards another [country|e], with the goal of checking any potential aggression. Members of a coalition will defend each other if the target attacks one of them, and may declare [war|e] on the target.

name: Colonial Federation
description: A group of different colonial governments that have banded together for protection from their enemies and to benefit from mutual cooperation and growth.

name: Crusade
description: When a band of like-minded countries come together to rid themselves of heathens, driven by the Pope.

name: Defensive League
description: A Defensive League is a group of [countries|e] that mutually agree to defend each other if [war|e] is declared upon one of them.

name: Balkan League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('foreign_league_balkan').GetLeaderCountry.GetName]. Hailing from centuries past, this league comes to [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] in order to press old claims or forge new ones.

name: French League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('foreign_league_france').GetLeaderCountry.GetName], this confederation symbolizes the aspiration of taming [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] and establishing a steady monopoly over her wealth.

name: Holy Roman League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('foreign_league_hre').GetLeaderCountry.GetName]. Despite the Emperor's best attempts, [ShowRegionName('italy_region')] has always been a contested battleground between outsiders and members of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName].

name: Iberian League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('foreign_league_iberia').GetLeaderCountry.GetName]. Hailing from the western reaches of [ShowContinentName('europe')], this league wishes to subjugate the peninsula and bring the [ShowCultureGroupName('italian_group')] folk under firm control.

name: Guelphs
description: The $guelphs_io$ are a group of [ShowCultureGroupName('italian_group')] states who align themselves with the interests of the [GetCountry('PAP').GetLongName] in [ShowRegionName('italy_region')].

name: Ghibellines
description: The $ghibellines_io$ are a group of [ShowCultureGroupName('italian_group')] states who align themselves with the interests of the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('hre').GetName] in [ShowRegionName('italy_region')].

name: High Kingship
description: As power waxes and wanes throughout the millennia, occasionally a powerful leader will gather enough might and support to claim the title of High King, a great overlord of the Celtic peoples.

name: Hindu Branch
description: A branch is a group of traditions and beliefs inside [ShowReligionName('hindu')] giving prominence to one or more specific [gods|e].

name: Holy Roman Empire
description: The glory of the ancient Roman Empire lives in the memory of all in [ShowContinentName('europe')]. [GetCharacter('fra_charlemagne').GetName] was crowned Roman Emperor, but it was not until the coronation of [GetCharacter('ogk_otto_liudolfinger').GetName] that the current $hre$ was born, with the ambitions of forming a revived and unified European Empire.

name: Īlkhānān
description: The $ilkhanate$, or Ilkhanate, are the lands conquered by the Great $genghis_khan_name$, and later governed by his son [GetCharacter('hulegu_khan_borjigin').GetName] and his descendants. As such, it is also known as the $name_hulegu$ Ulus.

name: Independence Movement
description: It is time to shake off the shackles of our [overlords|e] and fight for freedom! Independence movements can begin at any time, but are more likely to occur if a [subject|e] is dissatisfied with life under their current leader. An independence movement can quickly gain supporters if we are unpopular.

name: First Italian League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('italian_league_1').GetLeaderCountry.GetName].$italian_league_key_desc$

name: Second Italian League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('italian_league_2').GetLeaderCountry.GetName].$italian_league_key_desc$

name: Third Italian League
description: A league formed around the capital of [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('italian_league_3').GetLeaderCountry.GetName].$italian_league_key_desc$

name: Japanese Shogunate
description: The lands of Japan have long been immersed in a complex political structure. Despite the Emperor being the titular leader of the nation, actual rule has been for centuries in the hands of the $JAPANESE_SHOGUNATE_LEADER_MALE$, and even that role was replaced by a regent during some periods. The different clans live in a constant struggle for supremacy and authority over the Land of the Rising Sun.

name: Jihād
description: When a band of like-minded countries come together to rid themselves of infidels.

name: Jurchen Confederation
description: A union of nomadic and semi-nomadic people under the banner of one clan, it offers protection from external threats while trying to quell internal infighting and promote unity between its various members.

name: Lordship of Ireland
description: English rule over Ireland lies in an uneasy state. Since the initial conquest around 1170, the Crown's direct control has been reduced to a rump administration around Dublin. It relies on a loyal Lieutenant and currently exercises only nominal control over its increasingly distant vassals. Descendants of the conquering adventurers — despite being rewarded handsomely with earldoms and baronies — are becoming more like their Gaelic chieftain predecessors in both language and culture, while others have slipped out of English control entirely.

name: Marriage Union
description: A special [union|e] which is created via a [royal_marriage|e]. Unlike a [GetInternationalOrganizationType('union').GetName], the $marriage_union$ can not be centralized and is more akin to a [GetInternationalOrganizationType('defensive_league').GetName].

name: Middle Kingdom
description: The Middle Kingdom refers to China, considered the cultural center of Far East Asia since Antiquity, and therefore in the center — or middle — of the world.

name: Red Turban Rebels
description:
#T Red Turban Rebels#!
The $red_turban_rebels$ are a group of disorganized and striving rebels who seek to overthrow the [GetCountry('CHI').GetCulture.GetName] overlords and claim the [GetInternationalOrganizationType('middle_kingdom').GetName] for themselves. Although they oppose [GetCountry('CHI').GetName], the loyalty of the $red_turban_rebels$ is only to their own ambitions.

name: Protestant Union
description: The $protestant_union$ is a defensive alliance of countries of the [reformation|e] which want to protect themselves from the growing hostilities of the [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] states of the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. Although founded by states of the [ShowReligionAdjective('lutheran')] and [ShowReligionAdjective('calvinist')] faiths, every member of the Empire who feels threatened by the overzealous counter-reformers may join this [international_organization|e].

name: Catholic League
description: The $catholic_league$ is a defensive alliance of [ShowReligionAdjective('catholic')] countries who wish to contain the growing influence and spread of the [reformation|e] within the [GetUniqueInternationalOrganization('hre').GetName]. Although inherently [ShowReligionAdjectiveWithNoTooltip('catholic')], [ShowReligionAdjective('lutheran')] and [ShowReligionAdjective('calvinist')] states can also join if they see a political advantage from working with the League.

name: Sect
description: A $sect$ is one of the many branches of [ShowReligionGroupName('buddhist')], each one focusing on different teachings and ways of following the path of the Buddha to reach enlightenment.

name: Shintō
description: The diverse set of beliefs and practices revolving around Kami worship that were present in $japan_region$ before the arrival of $buddhist$ got intrinsically tied to and blended with $buddhist_ADJ$ practices and concepts as $buddhist$ spread through $japan_region$. The Kami and $buddhist_ADJ$ deities were identified with one another, with both sets of beliefs becoming functionally inseparable. This gave rise to a particularly $japanese_group$ flavor of $buddhist$ blended with a $buddhist$-influenced Kami worship.

name: Sikhism
description: A religion founded by the teachings of the $character_title_guru$, it originates from the varied $hindu_ADJ$ faiths of $india$, and incorporates many influences from $muslim$. It believes in one creator, $sikhism_god_name$, and to conduct oneself honestly and selflessly for the benefit of all. It encourages connection with the divine through the use of contemplation and meditation, as well as recitation and music as ways to be conscious of God's presence.

name: Swiss Confederation
description: The $swiss_confederation$ - also known as the #italic Eidgenossenschaft#! - is a league of political entities home to the Swiss Plateau and the Alps. The [ShowCultureGroupName('swiss_group')] people have formed this union in order to defend themselves from the growing influence of the [ShowDynastyName('habsburg_dynasty')].

name: Tatar Yoke
description: The Tatar Yoke refers to various principalities of [ShowSubContinentName('eastern_europe')] that are subject to Tatar Rule as a result of their invasion in the 13th century. The most prominent of rulers is awarded the title of Grand Prince, and is tasked with collecting tribute from the other tributaries on behalf of the Golden Horde $rank_kingdom_horde_ruler_suffix_male$.

name: Tribal Confederation
description: A group of different tribes that have banded together for protection from their enemies and to benefit from mutual cooperation and growth.

name: $game_concept_union$
description: $game_concept_union_desc$
